plate_level_note: The Family of Man Master Checklist plate #456 (Section 40 BOMB, the only plate in that section) credits the Atomic Energy Commission as sole institutional credit. O'Brian (2008, 'The Nuclear Family of Man', History News Network — fetched via browser MCP 2026-05-12; see .scratch/loc-photo-0441-source-research.html) confirms that the MoMA original (January-May 1955) used 'a six-by-eight foot color transparency of test Mike, a thermonuclear explosion from Operation Ivy at Enewetak Atoll.' The NARA 558592 image is the aerial B&W version of the Ivy Mike cloud — consistent with the AEC commissioner credit and the Mike identification from O'Brian, but this specific NARA item has NOT been confirmed in a Tier-1 source as the actual touring-exhibition print. The Wikimedia Commons file page was fetched via browser MCP 2026-05-12; see .scratch/loc-photo-0441.html. Image resized from 1920x1523 px to max 1400 px using sips -Z 1400.
